description: This file contains Google Test unit tests for the HdmiCec Plugin, including initialization, method existence, and specific command tests assuming a C++ source file for testing HdmiCec functionalities within the RDK project.

classes.name: HdmiCecTest
classes.description: Base test fixture class setting up common test environment for HdmiCec plugin tests.

classes.name: HdmiCecDsTest
classes.description: Derived test fixture class with mock objects for testing HdmiCec plugin with dependencies mocked.

classes.name: HdmiCecInitializedTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing initialization and event handling of HdmiCec plugin with mocked system components.

classes.name: HdmiCecInitializedEventTest
classes.description: Extended test fixture for testing event subscriptions and notifications with mocking of events and external services.

methods.name: RegisteredMethods
methods.description: Test that verifies the existence of key JSON-RPC methods in the handler.

methods.name: getEnabledFalse
methods.description: Test that verifies getEnabled returns false when CEC is not enabled.

methods.name: getEnabledTrue
methods.description: Test that verifies getEnabled returns true when CEC is enabled.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatusTrue
methods.description: Test for verifying getActiveSourceStatus returns true after sending a specific message.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatusFalse
methods.description: Test for verifying getActiveSourceStatus returns false when no active source is set.

methods.name: getCECAddress
methods.description: Test that mocks system event handler updates and verifies retrieval of CEC physical address and logical address.

methods.name: cecAddressesChanged
methods.description: Test verifying that the handler receives CEC address change events and publishes the expected JSON RPC message.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Test that simulates device list population and verifies correct JSON response with device details.
